skins.name: Betsushi
skins.description: Traditional clothing of Higashi . It is meticulously crafted from high-quality fabrics, with vibrant colors and elegant patterns. The design is comfortable and warm, making it suitable for autumn outings.

skins.name: Fly Into the Street
skins.code: Monster Hunter Collaborative Series/Fly Into the Street
skins.description: The Felynes are amped with excitement for getting some Terra -style fresh fits on, and spray paint-filled cans especially pique their curiosity. Noir Corne senses something big and bad's about to go down.
skins.image: /one-star-skins/Terra Research Commission - Fly Into the Street.webp

skins.name: Tsukiyoi
skins.description: Custom-made for Mint, integrating Victorian style into traditional Higashinese garb. Comfy yet unique, it is one of Mint's favorites on festive occasions.

skins.name: Yukibare
skins.description: Suzuran's outfit on a winter morning trip to the shrine. The loose-fitting sleeves protect against the wind and snow, while the pleated front adds an exotic touch.

skins.name: Scent of the Wild
skins.description: 以炎国产出的绸缎制成的传统踏青服装。在寒冷北地长大的人，也能感受到仲夏云雾的温暖氛围。
